name: quarter
description: Reference quarter of the observation, from 1 to 4
observations: ABS labels each quarter by its final month (Q1 March, Q2 June, Q3 September, Q4 December)

name: series_id
description: ABS time series identifier of the series
observations: Stable ABS Series ID (A-code); the series key, unique per combination of dimensions

name: statistic
observations: Harmonised across ABS workbooks: the same statistic is spelled differently between a release's quarterly and financial-year tables

name: household_type
description: Household type whose living costs the index measures
observations: The five ABS selected household types, defined by their principal source of income

name: commodity_group
description: Commodity group priced by the index
observations: All groups plus the eleven CPI commodity groups and the three separately published charge series

name: unit
description: Unit of the reported value, as published by ABS
observations: Units vary within a single ABS table, so the unit is carried per row rather than per table

name: value
description: Value of the series in the reference period, in the unit given by the unit column
observations: Carries no fixed measurement_unit: a tidy-indicator column whose unit varies by row and is given by the unit column
